newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Eletrobras approves 200 mln real financing.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Eletrobras approves 200 mln real financing.

text.p: Brazil's federal power holding company Eletrobras has approved financing of 200 million reais ($186.9 million) for the expansion of its electricity units, the company said in a statement.
The funds will go into 48 projects, estimated at a total cost of 600 million reais ($560.7 million), at 22 power firms in the Eletrobras system, the statement said.
The money will be disbursed over the next two years and is repayable over five years at an interest rate of 6.5 percent per annum after a two-year grace period, the statement said.

The projects include the construction and improvement of 11,000 km (6,875 miles) of electricity networks, acquisition of transformers and measurement equipment, the construction of 1,250 km (781.3 miles) of high-tension power lines and the installation and refurbishing of units in the Sao Paulo and Santa Catarina power generators Cesp and Celesc.

Eletrobras said another 400 million reais ($373.8 million) worth of financing may be approved this year to fund another group of projects also worth a total of 600 million reais ($560.7 million). ((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
